name: Attack on Titan: Paradis
desc:
Please note that this game is still in development, so many aspects are subject to change. The game will be updating gradually; stay tuned for more updates.

Mobile devices are supported (but may not run well on low-end devices)
Shutdowns = updates and bug fixes.

Game controls are mentioned in game.
You can join the community server to offer any suggestions or report bugs.

Inspired by the anime series Attack on Titan.
